basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old from Lewisville, Texas, working as a freelance graphic designer. I recently got married and love exploring new places with my wife. I joined Reddit to learn more about various topics and communities. My primary interests include animation (huge Paw Patrol fan here!), financial planning, and medieval history. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after work, as it fits my freelance schedule. Dislikes include waiting in long lines and unnecessary bureaucracy.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, and most of my financial knowledge comes from online courses and personal research. My interest in history, especially medieval times, is self-taught through books and documentaries.
